title: Private Banker - Consultor de investimentos (CVM, CEA, CFP)
description:
VAGA PARA NÍVEL BRASIL


Se você já é do mercado financeiro, e pensa em atuar em um modelo 100% alinhado com os interesses do cliente, podendo utilizar diversas plataformas (como BTG, XP, Ágora, Safra, C6..), recebendo um repasse atrativo, venha conversar conosco e conhecer o projeto da API CAPITAL Investimentos.

title: CRA II or Senior CRA
description:
We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.
  • May serve as preceptor, providing training to less experienced clinical team members.
  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.
  • Travel is required 50-80%.
  • All employees must read, write and speak fluent English and host country language
What ICON Can Offer You
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
Visit our careers website to read more about the benefits of working at ICON: ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below.
in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there’s every chance you’re exactly what we’re looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles.

title: AI Staff Engineer (Remote)
description:
AI Staff EngineerWe are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.


You’ll be responsible for empowering users to make the productivity revolution happen in their companies.


As an AI Developer at Pipefy, your mission is to leverage AI to solve user problems proactively! It can be programming a new feature, polishing existing features, supporting a team member, giving feedback, or solving a bug. Your role is crucial in driving our AI capabilities forward.


You'll have the opportunity to conduct and participate in experiments, make suggestions to improve our architecture and product and use tons of data to make the best decisions.


Since we are fully remote, you'll meet and work with people from all around the world.


One paragraph resume about what people can expect from working in this position (Mission in the role, responsibilities, seniority and what profile we are looking for).


Main Responsibilities:


- Develop new features from start to finish: through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance, as well as improve existing ones, focusing on AI-driven functionalities.

- Take responsibility for the system quality by driving testability together with architects and QAs to ensure that the way we design our platform enables controllability and automation.

- Take responsibility for system stability, ensuring proper testing and observability, actively monitoring production behavior, and reacting quickly to incidents.

- Share knowledge with the team and learn together. We believe knowledge is much more valuable when shared, so we’re always learning and teaching each other.

- Take part in the continuous improvement of Engineering processes, like recruiting, hiring, onboarding, documentation, incidents, tech talks, etc.

- Sought out for technical guidance on your squad and related ones, anticipate technical issues at the product level, and make architectural and design decisions to avoid them.

- Consistently reduce the complexity of projects, systems, and processes to get more done with less work. Breaks up deliverables to optimize for earlier feedback and incremental delivery of business value.

- Help the team develop a more robust engineering culture focused on quality and impactful deliveries by setting an example and mentorship.

- Identify and proactively create projects to fix Pipefy's architecture when preconditions change and current architecture is not optimal/fit anymore, extracting and documenting platforms whenever necessary.


Requirements:


- Write correct, clean code with periodic guidance; consistently follows best practices, including tests (unit, functional, integration).

- Exceptional proficiency in Python, LLM applications and AI model integration.

- Design and develop code to provide an integrated and managed development life cycle for traditional and generative ML applications.

- Experience using LLM-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph and others.

- Experience in implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and working with vector databases.

- Have practical knowledge about infrastructure, service architectures, tools, libraries, frameworks, continuous integration, and continuous deployment systems.

- Able to seamlessly learn and guide others across large sections of our codebase.

- Actively contributes to the technical design of features.

- Understand and make well-reasoned design tradeoffs in their area.

- Strong ability with RESTful.


Bonus point:


- Experience in fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs.

- Infrastructure: Cloud Computing, AWS, Networks, Load Balancers, Web Servers, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Disaster Recovery, Monitoring.

- Experience with document processing and data extraction pipelines.

- Experience with GraphQL apis.

- You have a sharp eye for UX/UI, and you work user-centered.

- Experience with different types of methodologies and tools for Unit, Integration and End to End testing.

- Have good communication in oral and written English.

- Experience working on agile and lean methodologies.

- Experience building and scaling complex, high-performance, high-transaction applications.


Benefits:

- Flexible Hours (in compliance with daily work hours)

title: Especialista Mobile - React Native
description:
Organização de grande porte busca profissional com sólida experiência técnica para liderar uma equipe de desenvolvimento focada em aplicações móveis React Native. O desafio envolve atuar como referência técnica, direcionando o desenvolvimento de funcionalidades estratégicas e promovendo a excelência do produto. O ambiente é dinâmico, inovador e orientado a resultados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Definir arquitetura e padrões de desenvolvimento para aplicações React Native, assegurando qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Orientar e desenvolver o time técnico, promovendo crescimento profissional e colaboração.
  • Interagir com outras áreas para garantir entregas eficazes e seguras.
  • Realizar revisões de código, assegurando aderência a padrões, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar na gestão de projetos, estimando prazos, acompanhando progresso e removendo obstáculos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento mobile, com foco em React Native.
  • Domínio de JavaScript, TypeScript e fundamentos de front-end.
  • Vivência com APIs RESTful e integrações back-end.
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança para desenvolvimento mobile (OWASP Mobile Top Ten).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise estática e dinâmica de código (SAST/DAST).
  • Atuação com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em NodeJS.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo Android (Java/Kotlin) ou iOS (Swift/Objective-C).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Vivência em cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Contribuições para projetos open-source.


Comportamentais:

  • Liderança colaborativa e inspiradora.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva.
  • Respeito à diversidade e postura ética.
  • Humildade e responsabilidade.

title: Engenheiro IA
description:
A posição de AI Software Architect exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).
  • Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente.
  • Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas.
  • Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções.
  • Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders.


Requisitos e qualificações

description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

Job Title: Audio Transcription Specialist (Language: Portuguese, Location: Portugal)


About The Role:

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance . The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurately converting audio content into written text, maintaining high standards of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen carefully to audio recordings and transcribe them into clear, accurate, and grammatically correct text .
  • Identify and correct transcription errors , ensuring proper spelling, punctuation, and formatting.
  • Handle different accents, speech clarity levels, and background noises with attention to detail.
  • Tag and label transcriptions as per project guidelines.
  • Review, proofread, and edit transcripts for quality, accuracy, and completeness .
  • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets .
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines .
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects .
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks .
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.

Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .

This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

title: Senior Backend (Node+Python) Engineer
description:
Senior Backend (Node+Python) Engineer

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join one of our key partners in building the next generation of digital commerce infrastructure. This role is focused on creating high-performance, scalable backend services that power mission-critical features for large-scale retailers and digital platforms. You will be part of a team that is shaping backend architecture, ensuring reliability under high transaction volume, and driving continuous innovation in a cloud-native environment.

- Develop scalable and reliable systems capable of supporting high-traffic environments.

- Implement data validation and service architecture using frameworks such as FastAPI and Pydantic.

- Optimize and manage relational databases using PostgreSQL, ensuring performance and data integrity.

- Deploy, monitor, and scale services in Google Cloud Platform, using best practices for cloud-native development.

- Integrate backend services with Firebase for authentication, messaging, or real-time features.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and contribute to architectural decisions.

Requirements

- 5+ years of professional experience in backend engineering with Node.js and Python.

- Strong expertise with PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization, performance tuning).

- Experience building RESTful APIs and backend services in production environments.

- Hands-on experience with FastAPI and Pydantic , or equivalent Python frameworks.

- Experience deploying and managing applications on Google Cloud Platform.

- Familiarity with Firebase services (authentication, cloud messaging, or data synchronization).


Nice to have

- Experience working with microservices or event-driven architectures.

- Knowledge of messaging systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ).

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines.

- Familiarity with observability tools and monitoring best practices.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

description:
Sobre a Verzo:

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.


Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.


Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.


Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.


Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.


O que fazemos:

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de  R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.


Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas/bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.


Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.


Prêmios e reconhecimentos: 

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S/A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.


Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas


Local de trabalho: 

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.


Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ


Requisitos mínimos:

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.


O que valorizamos:

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e/ou carteira de clientes ativa.


—


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.


Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack .Net
description:
Company Overview

SEW is the #1 Energy and Water Cloud Platform, providing cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions for Digital Customer Engagement, Field Workforce Engagement, and Smart AI/Machine Learning to the Energy and Utility sector. We empower utilities to enhance customer service, optimize operational efficiency, and maximize return on investments through the SEW platform applications leveraging mobile, AI, Machine Learning, and Cloud technologies.

Searching for your dream job? At SEW, we strive to help our employees find passion and purpose. Join us in changing the way the world uses energy and water and become part of our innovative and talented team!


Position Overview

We are looking for a Mid Level Full Stack .Net Developer with good experience with C# and Angular to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain robust web and mobile applications that integrate seamlessly with SEW’s platform. The ideal candidate will be passionate about building scalable and efficient software solutions and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Key Responsibilities

Application Development:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications using modern frameworks and technologies.
  • Build responsive front-end interfaces that deliver exceptional user experiences.
  • Develop efficient and secure back-end services and APIs.

Analysis and Reporting:

  • Perform thorough analysis of complex data and recommend actionable strategies.
  • Develop complex database queries in SQL/TSQL and NoSQL.
  • Translate client requirements to technical architectural specifications and communicate this to delivery teams and clients.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other developers, to define and implement solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality software development.

System Optimization:

  • Optimize application performance to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues promptly.

Innovation and Best Practices:

  • Define data architecture requirements for cross-product integration within and across cloud-based platforms.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Advocate for and implement best practices in software development, including testing, security, and CI/CD processes.
  • Write test plans and test cases to ensure application integrity is maintained.


Education and Experience Requirements

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in software development and product deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with .Net Core, .Net Framework, Angular, Entity Framework, Git, Unit Tests and Pipelines.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.
  • Expertise in MySQL, Oracle, or MS SQL Server (SAP HANA is a plus).
  • Experience with cloud architecture, including AWS, Azure, and Google (SAP BTP is a plus).
  • Effectively translate data modeling and BI requirements into the design process.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent human relations and documentation skills.
  • Strong ability to interpret customer and market insights and conduct data analysis.
  • Fluent English is required; Spanish is a plus.


Why Join SEW?

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization creating impactful solutions for the energy and water sectors.
  • Collaborate with a talented and innovative team on cutting-edge projects.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  • Work in a culture that values diversity, creativity, and collaboration.


SEW is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: GIS Python Developer

GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python ) and integrating them into Esri’s ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop QA/QC Scripts:
  • Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as:
  • Missing or invalid geometry
  • Polygon overlaps or gaps
  • Attribute inconsistencies
  • Coordinate system mismatches
  • Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly)


  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager:
  • Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling:
  • Automatic validation after data edits or updates
  • Flagging and reporting of errors for correction
  • Consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards


  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance:
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.


  • Collaborate Across Teams:
  • Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .
  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .
  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .
  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .
  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.
  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.


What You’ll Achieve

You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

What You Get:

This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals.

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

title: Analista de Atração e Seleção
description:
Quem somos?


A primeira unidade da AMAGGI, a Sementes Maggi, foi inaugurada em 1977 na cidade de São Miguel do Iguaçu, no Paraná. Dois anos depois, em 1979, tiveram início as atividades em Mato Grosso, com a aquisição de uma fazenda no município de Itiquira.


Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça.


Além disso, desde 1997 contribui para o desenvolvimento local e humano nas comunidades onde atua, colocando-se como parceira no desenvolvimento sustentável dessas localidades por meio da Fundação André e Lucia Maggi.


Sobre a vaga


Atribuições:

  • Conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta — desde a triagem de currículos até entrevistas, aplicação de testes e apoio à tomada de decisão;
  • Conduzir processos seletivos para posições em nossas unidades internacionais, adaptando estratégias de atração conforme o perfil local e alinhando-se à cultura;
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) dos gestores, mantendo-os informados e engajados durante todo o processo;
  • Ministrar integrações para novos colaboradores, garantindo uma jornada de entrada acolhedora e alinhada à nossa cultura;
  • Realizar processos de admissão e acompanhar a avaliação de experiência dos novos talentos;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente as nossas unidades em todo o Brasil nos temas relacionados à seleção;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica nas ações de marca empregadora (employer branding), fortalecendo o posicionamento da empresa em universidades, fóruns, feiras de carreira, cursos técnicos e demais canais de relacionamento com candidatos;
  • Contribuir com iniciativas que fortaleçam nossa cultura e promovam um ambiente cada vez mais inclusivo;
  • Utilizar sistemas de recrutamento e seleção (ATS) para garantir organização e rastreabilidade dos processos;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores da área (tempo de contratação, SLA de vagas, fontes de atração, entre outros), propondo melhorias contínuas nos processos e a melhor experiência para candidatos e gestores;
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de Atração e Seleção gerando insights para melhoria contínua dos processos e apoio à tomada de decisão.


Requisitos Necessários:

  • Graduação Completa em Psicologia;
  • Conhecimentos em condução de processos seletivos e entrevistas por competências;
  • Possuir CNH Cat. B e ter disponibilidade para viagens.


*Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todos os profissionais, sem distinção de raça, cor, gênero, idade, crença e deficiência (PCD)*

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.


Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Senior IT Support Engineer
description:
Job Description

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S. , serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus . We’ve raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history —and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.


We’re seeking an experienced Senior IT Support Engineer to join our growing team in a dynamic, remote-first startup environment. The ideal candidate will bring outstanding IT support skills, a deep understanding of cloud-managed infrastructure, and expertise in supporting a globally distributed workforce. You’ll be responsible for providing top-tier support to our global user base and ensuring smooth daily operations across hardware, software, network, and collaboration tools. If you have a proactive attitude, strong technical skills, and an interest in AI technologies, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Remotely design, manage, and troubleshoot IT infrastructure, including cloud-managed networks (LAN/Wi-Fi), and firewalls for our physical office hubs.
  • Lead IT infrastructure and collaboration technology projects for a distributed workforce, ensuring high availability, performance, and security.
  • Manage and enhance Workspace ONE UEM deployments for zero-touch device provisioning, lifecycle management, and security compliance.
  • Drive IT automation initiatives using scripting tools or low-code/no-code platforms to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.
  • Act as a customer experience champion, ensuring responsive, high-quality support for all employees, regardless of their location.
  • Provide expert IT support for our global teams across the US, India, LATAM, and Europe.
  • Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, security settings, integrations, and advanced troubleshooting.
  • Oversee the end-to-end IT asset lifecycle for a remote workforce, including procurement, zero-touch deployment, tracking, and secure decommissioning.
  • Support and optimize collaboration tools like Slack, Jira Service Management, Zoom, Confluence, and Google Meet.
  • Standardize and document IT processes, creating robust knowledge bases and support procedures for a remote-first environment.
  • Lead remote onboarding and offboarding operations, coordinating closely with Compliance, People, and Security teams.
  • Contribute to IT compliance efforts (SOC2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS) within a cloud-native infrastructure.


Skills and Qualifications

  • 7+ years of IT Experience, ideally with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role supporting a remote or hybrid workforce. English is a MUST have.
  • Proven experience providing exceptional IT support to a globally distributed, remote workforce.
  • Experience supporting Mac, Linux, and Windows platforms in a corporate environment.
  • Strong expertise in networking principles (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN)
  • Demonstrated success in driving IT automation or process improvements with measurable outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience managing a distributed IT asset lifecycle using modern asset management tools.
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace administration and automation.
  • Solid experience with Workspace ONE UEM or other modern MDM/UEM solutions (e.g., Jamf, Kandji, Intune).
  • Exceptional documentation, project management, and cross-team collaboration skills, essential for a remote-first environment.
  • Prior experience in a startup, fast-paced, or agile environment is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC2, PCI, ISO 27001.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer-focused mindset.
  • Passion for leveraging AI tools in IT operations or familiarity with emerging AI-enhanced IT solutions.



As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, Rain is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sex (including pregnancy), protected veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any unlawful criterion existing under applicable federal, state, or local laws. title: Especialista em SRE
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Você fará parte do time de SRE/DevSecOps responsável por uma plataforma de dados e inteligência artificial em arquitetura Cloud Native, base estratégica para diversos produtos da companhia.

Será um papel essencial na evolução técnica e cultural da infraestrutura, garantindo confiabilidade, escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência operacional.

A pessoa nessa posição liderará iniciativas de automação, observabilidade e resiliência, além de capacitar outras equipes a entregarem software com mais qualidade, agilidade e segurança.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde dos sistemas, criar alertas eficazes e garantir cobertura proativa de incidentes.
  • Responder rapidamente a incidentes críticos, coordenando mitigação, comunicação e resolução.
  • Gerir mudanças, atualizações e implantações com foco em segurança, estabilidade e disponibilidade.
  • Construir e manter pipelines, bibliotecas e automações para provisionamento, deploy e operação em ambientes Cloud de alta disponibilidade.
  • Estabelecer e garantir padrões de security by design em infraestrutura, código e dados.
  • Projetar e evoluir soluções de observabilidade ponta a ponta, integrando logs, métricas, traces e eventos.
  • Gerenciar e melhorar indicadores de confiabilidade (SLIs, SLOs, MTTR, MTTA).
  • Conduzir post-mortems blameless e implementar ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Influenciar decisões arquiteturais e operacionais visando resiliência, escalabilidade e custo eficiente.
  • Documentar padrões técnicos, playbooks e comunicar impactos técnicos em linguagem de negócio.
  • Definir prioridades estratégicas do backlog de SRE, equilibrando confiabilidade, velocidade de entrega, segurança e custos.
  • Apoiar auditorias, conformidade e governança de segurança em alinhamento com times de risco e compliance.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Domínio de conceitos avançados de SRE, DevSecOps e gestão de incidentes.
  • Automação de infraestrutura e pipelines em alto nível, utilizando Shell, Python, Go, Node.js ou Groovy.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade distribuída (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/Elastic Stack, Datadog, New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Atuação sólida com Cloud pública (GCP, AWS ou equivalente), incluindo provisionamento, automação e otimização de custos.
  • Experiência em CI/CD e DevSecOps avançado, com ferramentas como Git/GitOps, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Maven, SonarQube/Cloud.
  • Proficiência em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, Chef).
  • Vivência com serviços de mensageria e data streaming como Kafka, Redis Streams, Google Pub/Sub, Dataflow.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo PostgreSQL, AloyDB, MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, BigQuery.
  • Experiência em gestão de incidentes e troubleshooting em sistemas complexos, utilizando PagerDuty, Opsgenie, StatusPage, Splunk ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento em segurança da informação, compliance e governança de ambientes cloud (LGPD, Privacy by Design, SAST/DAST, IAM, Secret Management).
  • Familiaridade com ambientes de alto volume de dados, tráfego e experiência com design resiliente.
  • Experiência ou interesse em DataOps/MLOps, atuando com pipelines de dados e IA em larga escala (desejável).
  • Background em arquitetura e desenvolvimento de software, com domínio de versionamento, APIs, microserviços e padrões REST/gRPC.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares).
  • Uso de IA assistiva e ferramentas de produtividade como GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT ou similares (diferencial).
  • Capacidade de mentorar e influenciar tecnicamente outros times, promovendo cultura de automação, segurança e confiabilidade e fomentando a cultura de ownership sobre sistemas em produção.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações relevantes (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Security+).
  • Experiência com Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd) e políticas de segurança zero-trust.
  • Conhecimento em FinOps e gestão de custos em ambientes distribuídos.
  • Experiência com blue/green deployments, canary releases e chaos engineering.
  • Experiência com padronização de deploys por templates (Helm/Kustomize).
  • Prática com observabilidade unificada via OpenTelemetry e tracing distribuído.
  • Vivência em construção de plataformas internas (IDP), uso de Backstage, automação de ambientes.
  • Inglês Intermediário-> Avançado


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

title: Acquisition Editor, Life Science
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.


Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.


Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.


Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Coordenador de Logística
description:
Sobre a Vaga:


O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos. Essa função exige sólidos conhecimentos técnicos em logística para avaliar especificações, negociar com fornecedores e alinhar as atividades de compras às necessidades operacionais e estratégicas.

Ele/Ela se reportará ao Diretor de Compras Sub-Regional e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as fábricas e os especialistas locais em Compras de Transporte, a fim de garantir a continuidade do fornecimento e a competitividade das licitações dos fornecedores.


Principais Atribuições:


  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).
  • Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.
  • Negociar contratos e termos comerciais, visando otimizar o custo total e o prazo de entrega.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores (SLA, qualidade, pontualidade, custo), conduzir análises de negócios e estabelecer ações corretivas conforme necessário.
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas e operacionais para garantir que as compras atendam aos requisitos logísticos e de produção.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras que reduzam riscos e aumentem a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

-Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e atuar como um mentor técnico, disseminando a cultura de performance para toda a equipe de Front-End.

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3), Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


• Foco em Resultados: Orientação clara para melhorias mensuráveis (KPIs) de performance e SEO.

• Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas que atravessam múltiplas camadas (navegador, rede, servidor, código).

• Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar problemas técnicos complexos e as soluções propostas para audiências não técnicas (marketing, gestão).

title: Franchise Business Consultant - LATAM
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold’s Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.


Responsibilities:


Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold’s Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.


Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold’s Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.


Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.


Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.


Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.


Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.


Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.
  • Experience supporting international franchise or multi-unit business models, particularly in Latin America.
  • Strong presence and confidence when leading groups and delivering training in culturally diverse environments.
  • High level of business acumen, adaptability, and emotional intelligence.
  • Familiarity with Gold’s Gym tools, systems, or service providers.

description:
O objetivo é encontrar um profissional de social media que possua habilidades tanto em design quanto em redação. O público-alvo são seguidores e potenciais clientes nas redes sociais. Produzir artes e peças visuais utilizando ferramentas de design gráfico (como Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator ou similares), sempre seguindo o guia de identidade visual da marca.

Interagir com a comunidade online, respondendo mensagens e comentários de forma empática, clara e dentro da voz da marca.


Colaborar com outras áreas (como marketing, performance, design e atendimento) para garantir integração e consistência nas entregas.


Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências de redes sociais, comportamento do público e novas ferramentas de criação e análise.

Experiência prévia em gestão de redes sociais e criação de conteúdo (portfólio será considerado um diferencial).


Domínio de ferramentas de design gráfico, como Photoshop ou Figma.


Excelente escrita e criatividade, com capacidade de adaptar o tom de voz a diferentes plataformas e públicos.


Noções de fotografia, vídeo e edição básica, para criação de conteúdos ágeis e originais.


Conhecimento das principais métricas de engajamento, alcance e conversão em plataformas como Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn e Facebook.


Capacidade de organização e autogestão, com atenção a prazos e detalhes.


Perfil colaborativo, proatividade e interesse genuíno em criar conteúdo relevante e de impacto.

Perfil Profissional – Desenvolvedor Java | Pleno

Desenvolvedor Java com sólida experiência em sistemas distribuídos e arquitetura de microsserviços, especializado em autenticação, autorização e protocolos de segurança como OAuth2, OpenID Connect e JWT. Atua com foco no desenvolvimento de mecanismos de Single Sign-On (SSO) para ambientes corporativos, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e conformidade com padrões modernos de identidade digital.

Com domínio em Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Keycloak, Azure AD, Auth0 e outras soluções de identidade, projeta fluxos de autenticação robustos e integrações seguras entre múltiplos sistemas internos e externos. Possui expertise na implementação de Identity Providers (IdP), Resource Servers e Authorization Servers, bem como na configuração de clients OAuth2 com grant types como Authorization Code, Client Credentials, e Refresh Tokens.

Também é responsável por definir estratégias de controle de acesso baseado em roles (RBAC) e atributos (ABAC), configuração de políticas de autorização, integração com diretórios corporativos (LDAP, AD), e hardening de endpoints REST com escopos e claims personalizados.

Competências Técnicas

Linguagem: Java 8–21

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Apache Camel

SSO & Identity: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, SAML 2.0, Keycloak, Auth0, Azure Active Directory, Okta

Segurança: Criptografia, JWK/JWS, HTTPS/TLS, CORS, CSRF, PKCE

Integrações: LDAP, Active Directory, SCIM

Testes: Testcontainers, JUnit, Mockito, integração com testes de segurança

DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD com Jenkins, GitLab ou GitHub Actions

Experiência na migração de sistemas legados para arquiteturas modernas com SSO.

Atuação direta no desenho e implementação de Identity Providers e Authorization Servers próprios.

Capacidade de liderar times na definição de padrões de autenticação e segurança em ambientes corporativos.

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment
